تضطهدي (form VIII)
# تَضْطَهِدِي (taḍṭahidī) /tadˤ.tˤa.hi.diː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِضْطَهَدَ (iḍṭahada)
# تُضْطَهَدِي (tuḍṭahadī) /tudˤ.tˤa.ha.diː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِضْطَهَدَ (iḍṭahada)
